Risk: Spurious correlation-based medical decision errors in predictive models
Problem analysis: Opaque model decision processes hiding confounders
Theoretical insight: Interpretability reveals hidden model logic
Design rationale: Adoption of interpretable models in high-stakes contexts
Implementation mechanism: Apply rule-based surrogate models and attribution methods
Validation evidence: Asthma rule discovery via interpretable model audit prevented harmful recommendation
Intervention: Conduct interpretability audits with surrogate models during pre-deployment testing to identify spurious correlations
Source: https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/gYfgWSxCpFdk2cZfE/the-alignment-problem-machine-learning-and-human-values
